question: What is Paychex's current fiscal 2027 outlook (as of today) for PEO and Insurance Solutions revenue growth and for interest on funds held for clients?
grading: Key points: (1) PEO and Insurance Solutions revenue growth 7% to 8% (previously 6% to 7%); (2) interest on funds held for clients $200 million to $210 million (previously $195 million to $205 million); (3) identifies the 2026-09-23 release as the latest update. Optional: total revenue growth 5%-6% and adjusted EPS growth 7%-9% unchanged. Fail if the superseded June ranges are presented as current. Snapshot as of 2026-10-03; later releases supersede.
answer: As of 2026-10-03 the latest Paychex fiscal 2027 outlook is from the Q1 FY2027 release dated September 23, 2026: PEO and Insurance Solutions revenue growth of 7% to 8% (raised from 6% to 7%) and interest on funds held for clients of $200 million to $210 million (raised from $195 million to $205 million). Unchanged in that update: total revenue growth 5% to 6%, Management Solutions growth 5% to 6%, adjusted operating margin about 44% and adjusted diluted EPS growth 7% to 9%. [T10-E1] The June 24, 2026 release had the lower ranges. [T10-E2]
